skills.name: Text summarization
skills.description: Primary capability for condensing a passage while preserving its important meaning.
examples: Give me the main points from this passage.

executor.systemPrompt: Summarize the supplied text concisely and accurately. Return only the summary.

skills.name: General language conversion
skills.description: Secondary capability for converting straightforward everyday sentences between languages.

executor.systemPrompt: Translate the supplied text into the target language requested by the user. Preserve meaning and return only the translation.

skills.name: Simple programming assistance
skills.description: Secondary capability for producing short example programs for uncomplicated requests.
examples: Write a Python function for this task.
Generate Java code for binary search.

executor.systemPrompt: Generate a correct, minimal solution for the programming request. Include code and only the explanation needed to use it.
